_comment: The pinned Chromium engine artifact. `engine_version` is OUR wrapper framework's version (bumped on every native change); `cef_version` is the CEF binary distribution it was built against (cef-builds.spotifycdn.com). `sha256`/`size` are filled in by scripts/publish_chromium_engine.sh after the artifact is uploaded to the release named in base_url; null means not published yet, and the preference reports the engine as unavailable. See docs/CHROMIUM_ENGINE.md.
